GER 211.finalExam: Oral exam at the time in the university Final Exam Schedule; details to be discussed during the semester.

materials.item: Crowner and Lill, Impulse: Kommunikatives Deutsch fuer die Mittelstufe, 2nd ed. (Houghton Mifflin, 1999)
Brussig, Am kuerzeren Ende der Sonnenallee (Fischer, 2001)

GER 211.attendance: Taken daily. Three absences allowed without penalty; each additional absence costs 1 percentage point (1% = 10 points) off the final grade. Excusing an emergency absence needs a letter from the Emerge
GER 211.lateWork: No late homework (occasionally accepted until 5:00 on the due day, but not more than occasionally); no late essays under any circumstances.
GER 211.makeups: No make-up exams. Substantiated family emergencies or illness verified by a doctor's note are treated as exceptions.

components.item: Undergraduate: two papers in German, 4-5 pages each
components.note: due Oct. 3 and Nov. 9; topic chosen from several provided

components.item: Undergraduate: final paper in German or English, 6-7 pages
components.note: own topic; abstract and short bibliography by e-mail (schedule shows Nov. 14); at least three secondary sources; due Dec. 12

components.item: Undergraduate: seminar presentation (10-15 minutes, in German)
components.note: needs a Thesenblatt and copies for classmates
more than three absences will affect the grade

components.item: Graduate: one paper in German or English, about 15 pages
components.note: first section due Oct. 17, second section Nov. 14, complete paper Dec. 12
